## 10.4 An acknowledgment of service in a limitation claim must be in form ADM16B.

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 10.4 An acknowledgment of service in a limitation claim must be in form ADM16B.] 10.5 An application for a restricted limitation decree must be in form ADM17 and the decree issued by the court on such an application must be in form ADM18.

## 10.6 An application for a general limitation decree must be in form ADM17A.

## 10.7 Where –

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 10.7 Where –] (1) the right to limit is not admitted; and

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 10.7 Where –] (2) the claimant seeks a general limitation decree in form ADM17A,

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 10.7 Where –] the claimant must, within 7 days after the date of the filing of the defence of the defendant last served or the expiry of the time for doing so, apply for an appointment before the Registrar for a case management conference.

## 10.8 On an application under rule 61.11(12) the Registrar may –

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 10.8 On an application under rule 61.11(12) the Registrar may –] (1) grant a general limitation decree; or

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 10.8 On an application under rule 61.11(12) the Registrar may –] (2) if he does not grant a decree –

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 10.8 On an application under rule 61.11(12) the Registrar may –] (a) order service of a defence; and

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 10.8 On an application under rule 61.11(12) the Registrar may –] (c) make such other case management directions as may be appropriate.

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 10.8 On an application under rule 61.11(12) the Registrar may –] 10.9 The fact that a limitation fund has lapsed under rule 61.11(20)(a) does not prevent the establishment of a new fund.

## 10.9A A limitation fund may be constituted by—

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 10.9A A limitation fund may be constituted by—] (1) making a payment into court;

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 10.9A A limitation fund may be constituted by—] (2) providing court-approved security; or

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 10.9A A limitation fund may be constituted by—] (3) a combination of (1) and (2).

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 10.9A A limitation fund may be constituted by—] 10.10 Where a limitation fund is established by making a payment into court, the sum paid in must be –

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 10.9A A limitation fund may be constituted by—] (1) the sterling equivalent of the number of special drawing rights to which [the claimant] claims to be entitled to limit his liability under the Merchant Shipping Act 1995; together with

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 10.9A A limitation fund may be constituted by—] (2) interest from the date of the occurrence giving rise to his liability to the date of payment into court.

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 10.9A A limitation fund may be constituted by—] 10.11 Where the claimant does not know the sterling equivalent referred to in paragraph 10.10(1) on the date of payment into court he may –

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 10.9A A limitation fund may be constituted by—] (1) calculate it on the basis of the latest available published sterling equivalent of a special drawing right as fixed by the International Monetary Fund; and

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 10.9A A limitation fund may be constituted by—] (2) in the event of the sterling equivalent of a special drawing right on the date of payment into court being different from that used for calculating the amount of that payment into court the claimant may –

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 10.9A A limitation fund may be constituted by—] (a) make up any deficiency by making a further payment into court which, if made within 14 days after the payment into court, will be treated, except for the purpose of the rules relating to the accrual of interest on money paid into court, as if made on the date of that payment into court; or

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 10.9A A limitation fund may be constituted by—] (b) apply to the court for payment out of any excess amount (together with any interest accrued) paid into court.

## 10.12 An application under paragraph 10.11(2)(b) –

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 10.12 An application under paragraph 10.11(2)(b) –] (1) may be made without notice; and

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 10.12 An application under paragraph 10.11(2)(b) –] (2) must be supported by evidence proving, to the satisfaction of the court, the sterling equivalent of the appropriate number of special drawing rights on the date of payment into court.

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 10.12 An application under paragraph 10.11(2)(b) –] 10.13 The claimant must give notice in writing to every defendant and interested party whose address the claimant knows, of –

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 10.12 An application under paragraph 10.11(2)(b) –] (1) any payment into court specifying –

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 10.12 An application under paragraph 10.11(2)(b) –] (a) the date of the payment in;

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 10.12 An application under paragraph 10.11(2)(b) –] (b) the amount paid in and how it has been calculated;

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 10.12 An application under paragraph 10.11(2)(b) –] (c) the amount and rate of interest included; and

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 10.12 An application under paragraph 10.11(2)(b) –] (d) the period to which it relates; and

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 10.12 An application under paragraph 10.11(2)(b) –] (2) any excess amount (and interest) paid out to him under paragraph 10.11(2)(b).

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 10.12 An application under paragraph 10.11(2)(b) –] 10.13A Where a claimant wishes to establish a limitation fund (in whole or in part) by providing security, the claimant must apply to the court for an order approving the security.  The application may be made on paper and without notice, but the applicant should first seek to agree the provider, form, nature, and terms of the proposed security with any named defendant and any interested party before making the application (unless the circumstances of the case make that impracticable).

## 10.13B An application under paragraph 10.13A must be –

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 10.13B An application under paragraph 10.13A must be –] (1) accompanied by the proposed security or a draft thereof; and

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 10.13B An application under paragraph 10.13A must be –] (2) supported by evidence of—

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 10.13B An application under paragraph 10.13A must be –] (a) the adequacy of the proposed security; and

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 10.13B An application under paragraph 10.13A must be –] (b) if the proposed security is expressed in sterling, the sterling equivalent of the appropriate number of special drawing rights on the date the application is made.

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 10.13B An application under paragraph 10.13A must be –] 10.13C The court shall approve the proposed security if it is satisfied that it is adequate in all the circumstances (including its form, nature, terms, and the financial standing of the person offering it).

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 10.13B An application under paragraph 10.13A must be –] 10.13D Where a limitation fund is established (in whole or in part) by providing court-approved security, the security may be expressed in special drawing rights or sterling. If the security is expressed in sterling, the amount of the security shall be the same as if the fund were being constituted by payment in to court and paragraphs 10.10 and 10.11(1) above shall apply in an equivalent sense.

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 10.13B An application under paragraph 10.13A must be –] 10.13E The claimant must give notice in writing to every named defendant and any interested party whose address is known of any court-approved security lodged at court, specifying—

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 10.13B An application under paragraph 10.13A must be –] (1) the terms of the security;

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 10.13B An application under paragraph 10.13A must be –] (2) the date on which the security was lodged at court;

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 10.13B An application under paragraph 10.13A must be –] (3) how the amount of security was calculated;

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 10.13B An application under paragraph 10.13A must be –] (4) the amount and rate of interest included, and the period to which it relates,

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 10.13B An application under paragraph 10.13A must be –] and shall provide on request any person so notified with a copy of the security so lodged and the application made under paragraph 10.13A.

## 10.13F An application to set aside the court’s approval of a security may be made by—

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 10.13F An application to set aside the court’s approval of a security may be made by—] (1) any person (whether a defendant, an interested party or another), who was not given notice of the claimant’s application under paragraph 10.13A; or

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 10.13F An application to set aside the court’s approval of a security may be made by—] (2) any person (whether a defendant, an interested party or another) if circumstances relevant to the adequacy of the security have changed since it was approved by the court.

## 10.13G An application under paragraph 10.13F(1) must be –

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 10.13G An application under paragraph 10.13F(1) must be –] (1) made on notice to the provider of the security, all claimants, all named defendants, and all interested parties (whose addresses are known);

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 10.13G An application under paragraph 10.13F(1) must be –] (2) supported by evidence setting out the reasons why the court’s approval of the security should be set aside; and

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 10.13G An application under paragraph 10.13F(1) must be –] (3) made within 21 days of receipt by the applicant of notice given under paragraph 10.13E (if such notice was given to the applicant) or as soon as reasonably practicable (if no such notice was given to the applicant).

## 10.13H An application under paragraph 10.13F(2) must be—

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 10.13H An application under paragraph 10.13F(2) must be—] (1) made on notice to the provider of the security, all claimants, all named defendants, and all Interested Parties (whose addresses are known);

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 10.13H An application under paragraph 10.13F(2) must be—] (2) supported by evidence setting out the change in circumstances justifying the setting aside of the court’s approval of the security; and

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 10.13H An application under paragraph 10.13F(2) must be—] (3) made as soon as reasonably practicable after discovery of the change of circumstances.

## 10.13I On an application under paragraph 10.13F, the court may—

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 10.13I On an application under paragraph 10.13F, the court may—] (1) confirm its approval of the adequacy of the security;

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 10.13I On an application under paragraph 10.13F, the court may—] (2) set aside its approval of the adequacy of the security; and/or

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 10.13I On an application under paragraph 10.13F, the court may—] (3) require the fund to be reconstituted in such manner and on such terms as it thinks fit.

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 10.13I On an application under paragraph 10.13F, the court may—] 10.13J If a claimant has constituted a fund by payment in of money, it may apply at any time for an order permitting the reconstitution of the fund (in whole or in part) by means of a court-approved security. Any such application shall be made in accordance with paragraphs 10.13A to 10.13E, and paragraphs 10.13F to 10.13I shall apply to any order made.”.

## 10.14 A claim against the fund must be in form ADM20 .

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 10.14 A claim against the fund must be in form ADM20 .] 10.15 A defendant’s statement of case filed and served in accordance with rule 61.11(15) must contain particulars of the defendant’s claim.

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 10.14 A claim against the fund must be in form ADM20 .] 10.16 Any defendant who is unable to file and serve a statement of case in accordance with rule 61.11(15) and paragraph 10.15 must file a declaration, verified by a statement of truth, in form ADM21 stating the reason for his inability.

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 10.14 A claim against the fund must be in form ADM20 .] 10.17 No later than 7 days after the time for filing claims [or declarations], the Registrar will fix a date for a case management conference at which directions will be given for the further conduct of the proceedings.

## 10.18 Nothing in rule 61.11 prevents limitation being relied on by way of defence.

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 10.18 Nothing in rule 61.11 prevents limitation being relied on by way of defence.] 11.1 For the purposes of section 177 of the Merchant Shipping Act 1995 (‘the Act’), the Fund may be given notice of proceedings by any party to a claim against an owner or guarantor in respect of liability under section 153 of the Act by that person serving a notice in writing on the Fund together with copies of the claim form and any statements of case served in the claim.

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 10.18 Nothing in rule 61.11 prevents limitation being relied on by way of defence.] 11.2 Notice given to the Fund under paragraph 11.1 shall be deemed to have been given to the Supplementary Fund.

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 10.18 Nothing in rule 61.11 prevents limitation being relied on by way of defence.] 11.3 The Fund or the Supplementary Fund may intervene in any claim to which paragraph 11.1 applies, (whether or not served with the notice), by serving notice of intervention on the –

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 10.18 Nothing in rule 61.11 prevents limitation being relied on by way of defence.] (1) owner;

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 10.18 Nothing in rule 61.11 prevents limitation being relied on by way of defence.] (2) guarantor; and

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 10.18 Nothing in rule 61.11 prevents limitation being relied on by way of defence.] (3) court.

## 11.4 Where a judgment is given against –

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 11.4 Where a judgment is given against –] (1) the Fund in any claim under section 175 of the Act;

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 11.4 Where a judgment is given against –] (2) the Supplementary Fund in any claim under section 176A of the Act, the Registrar will arrange for a stamped copy of the judgment to be sent by post to –

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 11.4 Where a judgment is given against –] (a) the Fund (where paragraph (1) applies);

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 11.4 Where a judgment is given against –] (b) the Supplementary Fund (where paragraph (2) applies).

## 11.5 Notice to the Registrar of the matters set out in –

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 11.5 Notice to the Registrar of the matters set out in –] (1) section 176(3)(b) of the Act in proceedings under section 175; or

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 11.5 Notice to the Registrar of the matters set out in –] (2) section 176B(2)(b) of the Act in proceedings under section 176A, must be given in writing and sent to the court by –

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 11.5 Notice to the Registrar of the matters set out in –] (a) the Fund (where paragraph (1) applies);

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 11.5 Notice to the Registrar of the matters set out in –] (b) the Supplementary Fund (where paragraph (2) applies).

## References to the Registrar

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > References to the Registrar] 13.1 The court may at any stage in the claim refer any question or issue for determination by the Registrar (a ‘reference’).

## 13.2 Unless the court orders otherwise, where a reference has been ordered –

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 13.2 Unless the court orders otherwise, where a reference has been ordered –] (1) if particulars of claim have not already been served, the claimant must file and serve particulars of claim on all other parties within 14 days after the date of the order;

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 13.2 Unless the court orders otherwise, where a reference has been ordered –] (2) any party opposing the claim must file a defence to the claim within 14 days after service of the particulars of claim on him;

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 13.2 Unless the court orders otherwise, where a reference has been ordered –] (3) the rules concerning statements of case shall apply to the particulars of claim, the defence and any other statements of case served in the reference; and

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 13.2 Unless the court orders otherwise, where a reference has been ordered –] (4) all documents which the claimant (or counterclaimant) in a reference intends to rely on in order to show that the sums claimed were properly incurred and paid (‘vouchers’) shall be appended to their first statement of case in the reference and cross referenced to the sums being claimed, unless there is a compelling reason not to do so.

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > 13.2 Unless the court orders otherwise, where a reference has been ordered –] 13.3 Within 7 days after the defence is filed, the claimant must apply for an appointment before the Registrar for a case management conference.

## Undertakings

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > Undertakings] 14.1 Where, in or this practice direction, any undertaking to the Marshal is required it must be given –

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > Undertakings] (1) in writing and to his satisfaction; or

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > Undertakings] (2) in accordance with such other arrangements as he may require.

[This Practice Direction Supplements CPR Part 61 > Undertakings] 14.2 Where any party is dissatisfied with a direction given by the Marshal in this respect he may apply to the Registrar for a ruling.
